questions.subject: Bangladesh affairs
questions.text: Into how many sectors was Bangladesh divided during the Liberation War?
questions.explanation: At the sector commanders' conference in July 1971 the war front was divided into 11 sectors. Sector 10 had no fixed area: it was made up of the naval commandos.

questions.subject: Bangla literature
questions.explanation: 'Agnibina' (1922) is Kazi Nazrul Islam's first poetry collection. His famous poem 'Bidrohi' is part of it.

questions.subject: Mental ability
questions.text: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ? — what is the next number in the series?
questions.explanation: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, growing by 2 each time. So the next difference is 12 and the answer is 30 + 12 = 42. Or: 1×2, 2×3, 3×4 … 6×7 = 42.

pricing.title: Choose by how long you need to prepare
pricing.intro: Start for free. Any plan unlocks every test, every explanation and analytics.

app.title: On the bus, on a break, at night — the same account in the app
app.body: Pick up in the app exactly where you stopped on the web. Tests, results and bookmarks all in one place.

items.q: What do I get for free?
items.a: One full 100-mark model test every week, instant results and rank, and explanations for 10 questions in each test. No card or payment details needed.
Under the BCS preliminary rules each right answer gets 1 mark and each wrong answer loses 0.50. Unanswered questions lose nothing. Other exams follow their own rules.

items.q: Who is my rank compared with?
items.a: Everyone who took the same model test, using each person's first attempt. Your rank updates as more people take the test.

items.q: What if the internet drops during an exam?
items.a: Your answers are saved on your device and the timer keeps running. Everything syncs on its own when you're back online.
With bKash, Nagad or a debit/credit card. Your plan starts as soon as the payment goes through.

items.q: Does the same account work on the web and in the app?
items.a: Yes. Log in with the same number or email and your tests, results and bookmarks are the same on the web, Android and iOS.
